to: PERA: Plug-in Experts for Robotic Actions in Continual Whole-Body Control
ro: Motion imitation enables humanoid robots to acquire whole-body skills such as walking and dancing. However, fine-tuning an entire policy for a new skill can affect existing behaviors, while training a separate policy for each skill increases training and maintenance costs. t: PERA: especialistas em plug-ins para ações robóticas no controle contínuo de todo o corpo
r: A imitação de movimento permite que robôs humanóides adquiram habilidades de corpo inteiro, como caminhar e dançar. to: Direct-Ink-Writing of Soft Thin Film Force-Sensitive Resistors with Velostat and Printed-Carbon Sensing Elements

to: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility

to: RiSE-Drive: Risk-Sensitive Long-Horizon Candidate Evaluation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
ro: End-to-end autonomous driving systems increasingly rely on generating multiple trajectory candidates and selecting one for execution. In this setting, a central challenge is no longer only candidate generation, but how to evaluate candidates according to their long-horizon consequences under uncertainty. Existing methods still mainly use deterministic point scores, heuristic subscores, or single-outcome evaluations…

t: RiSE-Drive: avaliação de candidato de longo horizonte sensível ao risco para direção autônoma de ponta a ponta
r: Os sistemas de direção autônoma de ponta a ponta dependem cada vez mais da geração de múltiplos candidatos a trajetórias e da seleção de um para execução. to: Camera equalisation of an 11.5x drop in environmental illuminance: four imitation-learning policies on an SO-101 arm
ro: Real-robot benchmarks of learned visuomotor policies often record room illuminance as the lighting condition. r: Os benchmarks de robôs reais de políticas visuomotoras aprendidas geralmente registram a iluminância da sala como a condição de iluminação. r: A jogabilidade humana fornece observações, ações e consequências visuais combinadas que podem complementar o treinamento de políticas de robôs. to: Learn-To-Propagate: Distributionally Robust Motion Planning for Nonlinear Uncertain Systems
ro: Motion planning for stochastic systems aims to find a sequence of control inputs that drives a system to a goal set while avoiding unsafe states with high probability. r: O planejamento de movimento para sistemas estocásticos visa encontrar uma sequência de entradas de controle que conduza um sistema a uma meta definida, evitando estados inseguros com alta probabilidade. to: ReACT: Reflection-Consistent Modulation and Cross-Load Consistency for Humanoid Velocity Tracking Under Asymmetric Loads
ro: In recent years, humanoid loco-manipulation has progressed to whole-body grasping, lifting, and transport. ro: Humanoid motion interfaces should accommodate application-specific movement constraints while retaining useful reference behavior. r: As interfaces de movimento humanóide devem acomodar restrições de movimento específicas da aplicação, mantendo ao mesmo tempo um comportamento de referência útil. to: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
ro: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence.
